name: Yo Gabba Gabba!
description: Yo Gabba Gabba! is an American children's television show that airs on the Nick Jr. cable network in the United States and the Nick Jr. networks in the United Kingdom & Ireland, Italy, France and Australia as well as Treehouse TV network in Canada and RTE2 on RTÉjr in Ireland.  The show stars five costumed toys-come-to-life and their friend DJ Lance Rock, who explore a single topic in each episode through songs and short storylines in the half-hour program while teaching children life and social skills.  It also encourages viewers to move along with and dance with the characters in the program. The show is noted for its indie-culture guest stars and bands, and for drawing visual inspiration from 8-bit video games and H. R. Pufnstuff.

videos.title: Yo Gabba Gabba Live! - There's a Party in my City!
videos.overview: Join D.J. Lance Rock, Brobee, Toodee, Foofa, Plex, Muno and all of our favorite Yo Gabba Gabba! friends for their first-ever live concert. Get up on your feet to sing and dance along to Gabba favorites, including: There's a Party in My Tummy, Name Game and Get The Sillies Out. This concert is packed with special guests including Biz Markie, the incomparable Leslie Hall & DO IT teaching a Dancey Dance, Super Music Friends Show guest The Aquabats performs everyone's favorite, Pool Party.

videos.title: Circus
videos.overview: The gang helps Al the Ringmaster make a circus in Gabbaland; Brobee learns to be a clown, and everyone gets to perform. Black Kids perform ``We Love Clowns.''

videos.title: Bugs
videos.overview: Muno leads a bug tour through Gabbaland.  Plex shrinks the characters down to follow the Oskie bugs to their underground world where we meet the Queen Oskie Bug and watch eggs hatch.  Weezer performs ``My Friends Are All Insects.''

videos.title: Doctor
videos.overview: Toodee gets sick and needs to rest. The doctor visits and everyone helps Toodee feel better.  Of Montreal performs ``Bananas, Rice, Applesauce, Toast!''

videos.title: Superhero
videos.overview: Toodee encourages the gang to play superheroes; Devo performs ``Watch Us Work It''; The Aquabats perform.

videos.title: Baby
videos.overview: DJ Lance Rock shows videos of when the Gabba friends were babies; the gang spends time with Muno and Plex's families; Solange Knowles performs.

videos.title: School
videos.overview: Brobee and Toodee get past their fears and learn to enjoy going to school after meeting their teacher (Angela Kinsey) and taking part in show-and-tell.

videos.title: Fairytale
videos.overview: Lance reads a story to the characters where Jack (Muno) plants magic beans and clims a beanstalk to meet the Giant (Brobee) and his bean machine.

videos.title: Adventure
videos.overview: Muno and friends go on an Indiana Jones type adventure.  They travel through the jungle under Gabbaland and find a golden treasure.

videos.title: Treasure
videos.overview: Two special guests travel to Gabbaland to search for a hidden treasure with their compass.  Everyone joins in the search and they must also perform a special dance in a secret cave to unlock the treasure

videos.title: Flying
videos.overview: Brobee wants to learn how to fly. He meets a new friend on a cloud and they work together to fix the balloon.

videos.title: Clubhouse
videos.overview: Brobee and Muno build a clubhouse for boys only, and they won't let Foofa and Toodee play along. Can you Gabbaland friends sing and dance their way to a solution?

videos.title: Pets
videos.overview: Plex gives the gang pet-care tips when Foofa gets a new pet.

videos.title: Christmas Special
videos.overview: The Gabba Gang celebrates Christmas, but they couldn't think of any present to give Santa Claus.

videos.title: Olympics
videos.overview: The Gabba Gang start their own Olympics.

videos.title: Gooble
videos.overview: The Gabba Gang decides to cheer Gooble up by throwing a spooky costume party.

videos.title: Super Spies
videos.overview: Jason Bateman guests as the bad spy who steals all the balloons from the Gabbaland balloon art party. Guests: Jason Bateman, Biz Markie, & Peter Bjorn.

videos.title: Farm
videos.overview: DJ Lance and his Gabba Land friends visit a farm where Farmer Josh teaches them about farm animals, growing vegetables, living on a farm, and even holding a Farmers' Market. Plus, a good old-fashioned farmyard hoedown!

videos.title: DJ Lance's Super Music & Toy Room
videos.overview: After DJ Lance Rock sees that the star on his hat is missing, he goes back to his super music and toy room to find it.

videos.title: Shopping
videos.overview: After Plex runs out of the ingredients he needs to make pancakes, he and the Gabba Gang go to the supermarket to get more.

videos.title: Dinosaur
videos.overview: Muno, Brobee, and Toodee visit the land of the dinosaurs.

videos.title: Day Camp
videos.overview: The Gabba Gang go to day camp.

videos.title: Restaurant
videos.overview: The Gabba Gang goes to a restaurant.

videos.title: Show
videos.overview: DJ Lance Rock and the Gabba Gang are invited to the Swami's super music friends show.

videos.title: Mermaids
videos.overview: After Foofa accidentally drops her doll into a pond, she and Toodee meet a mermaid named Tammy. Together they go to the Mer-kingdom to find Foofa's doll.

videos.title: Quest
videos.overview: The Gabba Gang head to a medieval village to help a king regain order in his kingdom. They become friends with a naughty dragon bully named Carl.

videos.title: Mason
videos.overview: Mason goes to Gabbaland on a helicopter chair.
